title: ee.global_promotion.report.v2
description: Global promotion execution and review receipt. Near-duplicates produce a durable merge candidate for explicit curation review; proposal creation changes no memory and queues no search-index job. Exact compatible twins and unchanged previously applied reviewed merges are idempotent re-promotions.

executed.description: Whether the requested durable promotion or proposal operation executed; false for dry-run and refusal.

globalMemoryId.description: Global memory created, matched, or targeted by the merge proposal; null when no destination was selected.

alreadyPromoted.description: True for an existing exact compatible twin or an unchanged, previously applied reviewed merge. Pending, approved, and rejected merge proposals do not establish promotion.

indexJobId.description: Durable search-index receipt for a committed global memory, including unfinished work recovered on replay. Null for proposal-only operations.

mergeCandidateId.description: Deterministic curation candidate in the global store, retained when replaying its applied merge.

reviewCommand.description: Workspace-addressed ee curate show command for inspecting the global merge proposal before validation and application.
